% The lipics-v2021 class (and others like beamer, theorem.sty) already
% define common theorem environments such as {theorem}, {lemma}, etc.
% When build_minimal_preamble copies \newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem} from the
% preamble, the class's pre-existing definition causes:
%   ! LaTeX Error: Command \theorem already defined.
% Minimal reproduction using the acm class which also predefines {theorem}:
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
% Simulate the bug: define theorem twice (once the class would, once the paper)
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}  % duplicate causes the error
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
  Hello world.
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
